description:
Faceted full-text search over Ukrainian court decisions (ЄДРСР).

Hits are metadata with no reasoning text. What a court held comes only from
`get_document`.

`doc_type_name` tells a procedural ruling (Ухвала) from a merits judgment
without fetching it.

`q` is lemmatized inside the index; do not stem it first. Integer filters OR
within, AND across.

A null `total` is the index not answering, not a no-match.

cited_dokid.description: Only decisions citing these ua_law document ids.

exclude_judgment_code.description: Codes to drop; 5 is Ухвала, the procedural ruling.

judge.description: Exact judge name; Cyrillic case is folded.

limit.description: Max rows to return (0-200); 0 returns the count alone.

q.description: Free-text query, in the user's own words.

name: ua_edrsr__search
title: Search Court Decisions (EDRSR)
